## Ravenfield VR 1.16.12

- The M1 GARRET reloads again: an empty clip picked up off the ground was taken and left the bolt back with every full clip refused. The empty one now says EMPTY CLIP, and a clip at a shut bolt says OPEN IT.
- A sound that could not be found no longer stops what it sounds for. Since 1.16.10 one missing sound table made every sound lookup fail now and then, cutting a reload step in half (a clip in with the bolt still back) and leaving the holster, pouch and casing sounds silent for a while.
- A scope with a reticle of its own (the ACOG on the mk18 and the MG3, the MRAD, the AK-105 and others) is seen as it is, its own reticle on its glass, instead of under the mod's lens with a plain crosshair. It is not magnified then.
- No more of the mod's own scope over a real scope on guns whose model has a scope and a second, narrower sight mode (since 1.16.10).
- Inside a vehicle the view no longer slides about the cabin as it speeds up or brakes (the flat game's head bob, which moved your whole view in VR).
- In slow motion a grenade, molotov, C4 charge, ammo bag or round you throw flies at the speed you threw it until it lands (a grenade went at a fifth of the throw and dropped near your feet).
- A gun that comes with no reserve shows 0 in the pouch and on the wrist (it said the reserve was without end).
- A magazine dropped in a vehicle seat that fell through the floor no longer stays under the vehicle for good.
- The Air Horn blows on the trigger again, at what you point it at (it did nothing, and swung it hit like a club).
- C4 works: throw the charges with the trigger as before, then press A with the C4 in your hand to set them off (they could not be set off in VR at all). The C4 stays in your hand after the last charge.
- An ammo bag or medic kit flies the way you toss it (it always left at one fixed speed).
- At a mortar (the attack boat's) the right stick up and down sets its range; it was the mouse wheel only and stayed at its default.
- In a vehicle's gun seat, hold the grip of a free hand to aim: lock-ons that need aiming lock, and a gun's zoom and sight camera come in. Nothing aimed there before.
- A gun in the free hand kicks as its kind does in one hand, jolts the view, clicks with its own dry click, and its magazine is out of it while it reloads.
- A rocket held warhead first at the launcher's mouth says TAIL FIRST.
- A machine gun's belt hanging from its box no longer goes through the box when the gun is turned: the rounds' tips stayed inside it (seen on the MG3 ACOG turned on its side; measured clean in the game at every angle now).
- A gun in the free hand says OVERHEATED when it is too hot to fire, and a rifle taken into the free hand with its under-barrel launcher still selected goes back to the rifle.
- With the weapon's own arms (Hands = WeaponArms), a gun in your free hand sits in that arm's fingers instead of a few centimetres off them.
- A thrown ammo bag or medic kit no longer bumps the bag in your hand as it leaves.
